title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

errors: No real errors. For 2×2 matrices, N^2 = 0 is equivalent to det N = Tr N = 0 by Cayley–Hamilton. The 'non-zero on each fibre' condition, added in the margin, is needed and Grothendieck inserts it himself.

Minor imprecision, corrected on the next page. The correspondence N ↦ point of P (the line ker N = im N) is not bijective. Globally, N is a nowhere-vanishing section of the line bundle Hom(E/L, L), so N is determined only up to units. Such N need not exist globally for a given L unless that line bundle is trivial. The page's phrase 'à toute telle section correspond' is still correct as stated, since it goes only one way.

ideas.what: Equivalence between forms of GL2/SL2/PGL2, rank-4 Azumaya algebras and P^1-bundles
ideas.modern_name: Severi–Brauer schemes; twisted forms classified by H^1(S, PGL_2)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck (Le groupe de Brauer I, SGA3); classically Châtelet and Severi
ideas.where_published: Le groupe de Brauer I (Dix exposés); SGA3

ideas.what: P^1-bundle as the scheme of Borel subgroups; bijection of Borels under SG → G → PG
ideas.modern_name: Scheme of Borel subgroups Bor(G) ≅ G/B

ideas.what: Strictly nilpotent regular sections N (N^2 = 0) give borelian G_a-subgroups via λ ↦ 1 + λN; up to units these correspond to points of the conic det = 0 in P(fM)
ideas.modern_name: Nilpotent cone of sl_2 / trace-zero part of a quaternion algebra; root subgroups; the conic model of the Severi–Brauer variety
ideas.where_published: SGA3 (épinglages, root data), in general form

deep.surprise_reason: Standard recollection of SGA3-level facts about rank-2 forms and Severi–Brauer conics, setting up a canonical pinning. The only context-specific interest is its use for the loop equation, which is not yet developed on this page.
transcription_corrections: The duplicated '[-N-] N' is just N written once (a struck character before it).
In the margin, '{+et régulières (non nulles sur chaque fibre)+}' attaches to 'les sections' in line (1), defining the 'strictement nilpotentes' sections.
In (2), 'N(λ) =' is a superscript insertion above exp(λN).
